baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus moves from the ف ط ر opening of the upper and lower cosmic field to ج ع ل arrangement within that field.
baseline_models.mechanism: One agency initiates the maximal vertical whole and then configures relations inside it; cosmic origin and creaturely arrangement are two scales of the same action.

activation_trace.role: Beginning and bringing forth supplies the initiating action for the whole mechanism.
The overhanging upper realm supplies the mechanism's upper bound.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the complementary lower bound.
Putting something into a configured state turns cosmic initiation into internal ordering.

changed_reading.before: The opening title merely identifies the creator before unrelated gifts are listed.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a scale-continuous act: the total created field is initiated, then its living relations are deliberately configured.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ن ف س, repeated ز و ج, animal stock, and ذ ر ء links identity, pairing, and multiplication.
baseline_models.mechanism: Counterparts are drawn from the same living domains and joined into a relational arrangement; that arrangement becomes the medium in which populations are brought forth.

activation_trace.role: The very self or identity supplies continuity between each population and its counterparts.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies the relational unit.
Domesticated animal wealth broadens the mechanism beyond human spouses to managed living populations.
Bringing creatures into manifest existence and multiplying them supplies the mechanism's output.

changed_reading.before: Spouses are bestowed and reproduction is then mentioned as a separate benefit.
changed_reading.after: Paired differentiation is itself a divinely configured medium through which living populations are manifested and multiplied.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ل ي س negation governs م ث ل and every ش ي ء before hearing and sight are affirmed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction blocks every creature from serving as an ontological match, then affirms complete auditory and visual access without importing creaturely organs across that boundary.

activation_trace.role: Categorical denial establishes the boundary around the following comparison.
Similarity or equivalence supplies the relation that the negation disallows.
The unrestricted class of knowable, reportable things makes the exclusion comprehensive.
Auditory reception affirms access while the preceding denial blocks embodied equivalence.
Visual apprehension completes the affirmation of access without supplying a creaturely model.

changed_reading.before: A conventional transcendence formula is followed by two familiar attributes.
changed_reading.after: The attributes deliberately cross a guarded analogy boundary: they assert exhaustive access, not shared embodiment or membership in a comparable class.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root that names cosmic initiation in the focus returns as the heavens' near-rupture. Origination is therefore not inert manufacture but an opening power whose catastrophic edge remains bounded.

activation_trace.role: Initiation and bringing forth establish the constructive pole of the repeated root.
Splitting and cracking supply the same root's dangerous pole and turn creation into controlled opening.

structural_cues: 42:5 repeats both the heavens and the focus root in an intensive reflexive form, while praise and protection for the earth follow the threatened rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a same-root reversal from originating to almost splitting; I infer that the opening power is both generative and potentially rupturing, while the live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no deliberate linkage.

changed_reading.before: Originating the heavens is a completed act of production.
changed_reading.after: Originating is a continuously bounded opening: the heavens produced by it still stand at the controlled edge of fissure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A pair joins distinguishable counterparts without erasing them. The surrounding sequence contrasts this held difference with both an imposed single community and factional scattering.

activation_trace.role: Joined counterparts supply a unity that preserves relational difference.
Separated parties supply the first social image of difference becoming partition.
Making many into one supplies the explicitly possible but withheld alternative of imposed sameness.
Scattering a whole into parts supplies the prohibited opposite extreme.

structural_cues: 42:7 names two parties, 42:8 makes one community counterfactual, and 42:13 commands that the shared way not be fragmented.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, counterfactual oneness, and condemned dispersal; I infer a middle mechanism of relation without erasure, while the live alternative limits the later sequence to communal history with no bearing on the focus pairs.

changed_reading.before: Pairing is only a biological arrangement.
changed_reading.after: Pairing also images held difference: plurality can be joined without being flattened into sameness or broken into hostile fragments.

context_deltas.mechanism: Multiplication operates inside an administered economy: access can be opened, provision extended, or supply narrowed to a measured amount. Proliferation is governed throughput rather than automatic abundance.

activation_trace.role: Manifesting and multiplying creatures supplies the process whose inputs are later regulated.
Instruments that preserve and open what they control supply administrative access to the cosmic store.
Spreading and extending against contraction supplies the expansive setting.
Narrowing something to a small allotment supplies the counter-setting.
Deliberate estimation and management turn alternating expansion and restraint into measured governance.

structural_cues: 42:12 immediately follows the focus with keys, expansion, and restriction; 42:27 explains that unrestricted expansion would produce transgression and instead names measured descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjustable provision and a reason for restraint; I infer that provision bounds the focus's multiplication, while the live alternative treats the regulation as solely moral-economic rather than ecological.

changed_reading.before: The focus promises unchecked reproductive increase through pairing.
changed_reading.after: The focus describes proliferation within a keyed and measured economy whose sustaining inputs can be expanded or constrained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rain revives a receptive earth, mercy spreads, and moving creatures are dispersed through the cosmic field before being gatherable again. The focus's propagation shifts from a domestic reproductive scene to an ecological scatter-and-gather cycle.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive habitat.
Casting seed into land supplies the focus-side material model for propagation.
Life-giving rain descending from above supplies the habitat's activating input.
Rain reviving dry pasture supplies the transition from dormant ground to living range.
Scattering and distributing supplies the outward movement of creature populations.
Ground-level creaturely movement makes the dispersed population concrete.
Rejoining what was dispersed supplies the reversible terminal pole of the cycle.

structural_cues: 42:28 moves from rain to spreading mercy, and 42:29 immediately repeats creation of the heavens and earth while adding dispersed creatures and their possible gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain, revived pasture, creature dispersal, and gathering; I infer an ecological causal chain back to ذ ر ء, while the live alternative reads the gathering only eschatologically and the rain only as mercy.

changed_reading.before: The multiplication concerns humans and livestock reproducing in pairs.
changed_reading.after: The multiplication also evokes sowing and dispersal across activated habitats, with creaturely spread held inside a larger scatter-and-gather ecology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah installs balance and later measures a harmful act by its like, while pardon and repair can exceed that equivalence. Likeness is thus operational inside creaturely justice even as it is denied as a bridge to God.

activation_trace.role: Categorical denial excludes divine comparability.
The denied relation is equivalence or similarity.
A balance of justice supplies the institutional setting for legitimate comparison.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the legal operation.
Exact recurrence of the comparison root assigns likeness a bounded intra-created use.
Forgoing punishment supplies a possible departure from strict equivalence.
Removing estrangement supplies repair as the purpose that can outrank matching harm.

structural_cues: 42:17 pairs revealed truth with balance; 42:40 repeats the focus comparison root in a proportional-recompense construction and immediately opens onto pardon and repair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact root recurrence and a justice sequence; I infer a scope contrast between forbidden divine analogy and permitted creaturely equivalence, while the live alternative treats the two uses as independent.

changed_reading.before: The no-likeness clause is only a metaphysical denial.
changed_reading.after: The clause also reserves likeness for the created moral economy, where equivalence can be measured but reparative pardon may go beyond it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing creation sequence places gifted female or male offspring, combining the two, and making someone barren under parallel acts of will. Pairing is one sovereign configuration, not a deterministic fertility mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Making one thing a counterpart to another supplies the focus arrangement.
Lineage and offspring supply the reproductive expectation that the context qualifies.
Giving without exchange makes offspring a gift rather than an automatic product.
The focus root returns as an active combining of sexed counterparts.
Configuring a person into a condition places fertility states under the same arranging agency.
Barrenness in womb and offspring supplies the explicit non-proliferative condition.

structural_cues: 42:49 repeats ownership of the heavens and earth, then 42:49-50 coordinate gifting, pairing, and barrenness under repeated willing and making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel sovereign verbs and the explicit barren case; I infer that this syntax blocks a universal fertility promise in 42:11, while the live alternative limits the passage to a taxonomy of offspring outcomes.

changed_reading.before: Pairs are a universal reproductive engine through which every recipient is multiplied.
changed_reading.after: Pairing is a bestowed configuration through which proliferation may occur, while gifted difference and divinely made barrenness explicitly prevent fertility from defining the arrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unlike hearer-seer has unrestricted access to creatures, whereas human access to divine address comes through hidden conveyance, a barrier, or a messenger. The closing attributes encode asymmetric access rather than reciprocal sensory likeness.

activation_trace.role: Denied equivalence prevents the communication relation from implying symmetry.
Complete auditory reception supplies divine access from the creature toward God.
Penetrating inner discernment broadens access beyond bodily sight.
Knowledge conveyed hiddenly supplies one mediated direction from God toward the human recipient.
Placing something behind visibility supplies remoteness from direct encounter.
A screening barrier supplies the explicit limit on creaturely access.
Message and messenger supply a second mediated channel.

structural_cues: 42:51 excludes ordinary direct divine-human speech and enumerates mediated channels; 42:52 then describes revelation as a made light by which recipients are guided.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unrestricted hearing and sight on one side and hidden, screened, or messenger-borne speech on the other; I infer asymmetric access, while the live alternative leaves the focus attributes unrelated to the later revelation channels.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and seeing simply close the ayah as generic attributes.
changed_reading.after: They mark an asymmetry: divine access to creatures is unblocked, while creaturely reception of divine address remains mediated and therefore never models God's mode of perception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant و س م mapping for the focus's س م و occurrence rather than the ordinary sky root. It remains anchored because the split inventory is explicitly supplied and 42:29 calls the creation of those heavens and earth a visible sign. Downstream prose should present only a possible resonance of marked legibility, never replace the lexical sense of heavens with 'marks.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's س م و occurrence has a supplied split mapping to visible marking, and its closing ب ص ر invites discernment.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies the exploratory image of a legible cosmic surface.
Insightful discernment supplies the faculty by which marks become evidence rather than decoration.
A condition readable from its sign supplies contextual activation for the same split mapping.
An evident sign explicitly frames cosmic creation as something displayed for recognition.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only the upper half of the created domain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the heavens also function as a marked and readable field whose created features bear signs for discerning sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and branch-distant because it links two rare milking images attached to roots used with ordinary cosmic senses. It remains anchored in the focus's ف ط ر occurrence and explicit cattle domain, while 42:5 supplies the second material image. Downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy for recurrent measured emergence, not as a translation of either verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins the ف ط ر root to cattle and proliferation, allowing its small-yield milking branch to become materially active.

activation_trace.role: Drawing a small amount of milk with the fingertips supplies a gradual extraction image for origination.
The explicit cattle domain keeps the material analogy attached to the focus rather than free-floating.
Milk returning between successive milkings supplies replenishment and periodicity to the extraction model.

changed_reading.before: Origination is imagined as a single completed production event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, origination and proliferation may be pictured as recurrent measured yields drawn from a source that replenishes between releases.

strongest_changes: The 42:5 recurrence of ف ط ر turns static origination into a bounded opening whose other edge is cosmic rupture.
The 42:12 and 42:27 expansion-measure sequence makes proliferation administered rather than automatic.
The exact م ث ل recurrence at 42:40 confines equivalence to creaturely justice while divine comparability remains denied.
The coordinated gifts, pairing, and barrenness of 42:49-50 prevent 42:11 from functioning as a universal fertility guarantee.
The mediated speech channels of 42:51-52 recast hearing and seeing as asymmetric access without embodied analogy.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence made the focus's compact sequence behave as several mechanisms at once: controlled fissure, relational differentiation, measured ecology, bounded legal equivalence, reproductive contingency, and asymmetric communication. The supplied split mapping for س م و also preserved a contained marked-cosmos outlier that a dominant-root reading would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent and scope of the singular prepositional phrase attached to proliferation remain grammatically open.
The social held-difference model depends on reading the community sequence back through the focus's pairing image.
The marked-heavens and pulsed-yield readings are packet-licensed branch activations, not proposed lexical glosses.
